blocks.text: Kai bain-ul-aqwami (international) dhaanche AI ke zimmedarana istemal ki rehnumai karte hain. European Union ka General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) data privacy aur users ke huqooq par sakht qawaid lagu karta hai. Duniya bhar ke idaron ke banaye AI Ethics Guidelines jawabdehi, insaf aur insani izzat ke ehtram par zor dete hain. Yeh dhaanche mulkon aur companies ko zimmedarana AI apnane ki targheeb dete hain.

Pakistan ke liye qaumi AI policies banana zaroori hai taake nayi ijaad bhi ho aur akhlaqi usoolon ki pabandi bhi. Aisi policies data ki hifazat ke qawaid bana sakti, research ki hosla-afzai kar sakti, aur aise AI hal banane mein madad de sakti hain jo maqami aqdar aur zarooraton ke mutabiq hon. Akhlaqi miyar lagu karne se awam ka bharosa banta hai, bain-ul-aqwami shirakat milti hai, aur AI mulk ki tarakki mein musbat hissa dalti hai.

blocks.title: Pakistan ki AI policy
blocks.text: Pakistan ki wafaqi hukoomat ne 2025 mein National Artificial Intelligence Policy manzoor ki. Is ki taaza tafseelat ke liye sarkari dastavezat dekhein.

blocks.prompt: GDPR kya hai aur Pakistan ke liye qaumi AI policy ke do fawaid batayein.
blocks.explanation: GDPR European Union ka qanoon hai jo data privacy aur users ke huqooq par sakht qawaid lagata hai. Qaumi AI policy: data protection ke qawaid, research ki hosla-afzai, maqami aqdar ke mutabiq AI; is se awam ka bharosa aur bain-ul-aqwami shirakat milti hai.

blocks.prompt: Poore section 8.2 ka jaiza: AI talaba ke mazameen check karti aur dehi schools ke talaba ke saadi English mein likhe jawabon ko kam number deti hai. Kaun se akhlaqi usool khatre mein hain, aur kya karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Insaf (aik group ke khilaf bias) aur shaffafiyat (talaba nahi dekh sakte ke number kyun kam hain), aur nataij ki jawabdehi. Training data bias ke liye jaancha jaye, number asatiza dekhein, scoring samjhai jaye, aur istemal se pehle system bohat si qism ke schools ke mazameen par test ho.

items: International frameworks: GDPR aur AI Ethics Guidelines (jawabdehi, insaf, insani izzat).
Pakistan ke liye qaumi AI policies nayi ijaad aur akhlaqi pabandi dono ke liye zaroori.
